messages:
Samir: Quick sync — we need a small, deterministic telemetry bundle to share with Datadog + HW SI for the marketplace demo. Can we agree on fields and retention?
Tess: Agree. Goal: 1) reproducible traces/logs/metrics 2) minimal PII 3) maps cleanly to Datadog dashboard tiles.
Jordi: For HW SI, we need GPU-related attributes on spans (gpu.vendor, gpu.model, gpu.memory_mb) and a host-level metric for GPU utilization.
Kei: +1. Also specify semantic conventions versions (OTel v1.15+). Call out resource.service.name and deployment.environment.
Amelia (Datadog): That works. If you include `dd.trace_id` and `dd.span_id` we'll have direct linking in previews. Also please include a sample APM tag `redwood.deployment_id` so we can show routing.
Tess: Drafted a tiny schema, sending snippet:```json
{
  "resource": {"service.name": "inference-proxy", "deployment.environment": "staging"},
  "spans": [{"name": "model.generate", "attributes": {"model.name": "gpt-small", "seq_len": 128, "gpu.model": "A100-80GB"}}],
  "metrics": [{"name": "gpu.utilization", "unit": "%", "points": [[1680000000, 42]]}],
  "logs": [{"body": "cache hit", "severity": "info"}]
}```
Kei: Nice. Two asks: 1) Include an ingestion README with the OTLP collector pipeline we used. 2) Provide a tiny python generator (`samples/generator.py`) so SIs can replay events.
Samir: Proposed contract v1.0: - 5k spans total, spread across 3 services - 2k metric points (gpu/mem/cpu) - 1k logs with at least 3 severity levels - retention: snapshot file only (no external retention) - PII: none (mask user_id, session_id)
Jordi: 5k spans sounds fine for a demo. For HW perf slides we might want a peak burst file with higher qps — can be optional.
Amelia (Datadog): For dashboard wiring we need tile IDs and the sample queries. Can you include `dashboards/README.md` listing metric queries and example facets to show?
Tess: Will add. Example metric query we plan to include: `avg:gpu.utilization{service:inference-proxy}.rollup(avg,60)` and an example trace link pattern.
TelemetryBot: automated note: Uploaded sample bundle `partner-telemetry-v1.tar.gz` to the partnership drive (link: https://rwd.co/partner-telemetry/v1).
Kei: Action items: Tess -> write generator + schema, Samir -> create optional high-qps bundle, Jordi -> sample GPU attributes matrix, Amelia -> mapping for Datadog tile wiring. Timeline: 1 week for v1.0.
Samir: Can we also include a small smoke test script that calls the Redwood hosted API and emits telemetry so integrators see end-to-end? A curl snippet + Node/py example.
Tess: Yup, adding `smoke/smoke_py.sh` and `smoke/smoke_node.sh`. They'll hit a local mock that emits OTLP to a collector.
Jordi: One more: include a note about sensitive IP — hardware serials should be obfuscated in samples.
Amelia (Datadog): We'll prep a demo dashboard template; ask: do you want us to embed a sample tile with an interactive flamegraph?
Samir: Yes — flamegraph + a small trace waterfall on the right. Keep visuals lightweight for marketplace listing.
Kei: I'll open a repo PR `partner-telemetry-samples` and drop the draft. Share PR link here when ready.
Tess: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/partner-telemetry-samples/pull/12 — includes schema, generator, smoke tests, and dashboards/README.
Amelia (Datadog): Reviewing now. Quick feedback: add a `trace.sample_rate` attribute so we can demo sampling effects.
Samir: Good call. Also let's document recommended OTLP collector resource limits for the demo (mem 256MB, cpu 0.2).
Tess: Noted. Final question: approval for public copy in marketplace assets? We need legal sign-off if any sample contains vendor logos.
Kei: Looping in legal tomorrow. For now mark the bundle as internal until sign-off.
Samir: Thanks everyone — two follow-ups: 1) Tess to merge v1.0 draft 2) Amelia to share dashboard template 3) Jordi to drop optional high-qps bundle. Target close: next Friday. :thumbsup:
Amelia (Datadog): Got it — will send template + reviewer notes by EOD tomorrow.
TelemetryBot: automated reminder set for 7 days before target close.
